name: Hidden Packages
summary: 100 contraband packages concealed beneath docks, underwater wrecks, rooftop ventilation units, and abandoned motels across Leonida.
description: A trademark collectible format returning to Vice City, collecting packages yields weapon spawn deliveries at safehouses every 10 packages collected, culminating in infinite ammunition bonuses upon locating all 100.
reward: Tiered weapon unlocks at player safehouses and $250,000 cash reward.
locationsSummary: Scattered across ocean floors, back alleys, industrial parks, and high-altitude rooftop ledges.

seo.title: Hidden Packages Guide: All 100 Locations & Map
seo.description: Full map and walkthrough for all 100 Hidden Packages in GTA VI Vice City. Safehouse weapon rewards, underwater coordinates, and checklist.
